3: ## 1. 文档目标和结论
4: 
5: 本文是`BK7258_OPENVELA_AP_PORTING_PLAN.md`中UART0和Mailbox V2章节的可实施细化方案。依据当前工作区的OpenVela AP实现、`bk_avdk_smp` AP/CP源码、比赛仓CP覆盖文件、原厂网页文档和生成的内存布局，目标是在不占用CPU1物理UART1、不改变CP物理UART0下载和启动行为的前提下，实现：
6: 
7: ```text
8: AP/OpenVela输出
9:   NuttX console/syslog/NSH stdout
10:     -> AP MB_UART0 TX
11:     -> Mailbox V2 logical channel 0x19
12:     -> CP MB_UART0 RX
13:     -> CP shell TX queue
14:     -> CP UART0/GPIO11/CH340/PC
15: 
16: PC输入
17:   PC/CH340/UART0 RX/GPIO10
18:     -> CP shell UART RX owner
19:     -> 显式AP console输入模式
20:     -> CP MB_UART0 TX
21:     -> Mailbox V2 logical channel 0x49
22:     -> AP MB_UART0 RX
23:     -> NuttX serial upper-half
24:     -> /dev/console/NSH stdin
25: ```
26: 
27: 最终结论：
28: 
29: - `MB_UART0`本身是全双工、带软件RTS/CTS流控的虚拟UART，不是单向日志命令。
30: - AP发送使用logical channel `0x19`，CP发送使用logical channel `0x49`；两者都是同一个MB_UART0的本端发送编号。
31: - 每个Mailbox V2 envelope只携带16字节message的地址和长度；DATA message再携带固定128字节交换区的地址和有效长度。
32: - 当前本地AP实现只完成AP到CP的输出；收到CP DATA后固定返回成功但不复制数据。当前CP覆盖也只读取AP输出，没有PC到AP输入路径。

34: - 正式实现保持原厂16字节message、DATA/STATE和RTS/CTS线协议兼容，但必须修复本地实现的buffer所有权、ACK队列、reset、RX校验和NuttX serial接入问题；不得照搬原厂未初始化尾字节、未校验payload指针和失败后静默丢包等缺陷。

63: ## 3. 已确认的协议事实
64: 
65: ### 3.1 CPU和logical channel编码
66: 
67: logical channel为8位：
68: 
69: ```text
70: bit[7:6] destination CPU
71: bit[5:4] source CPU
72: bit[3:0] logical channel index
73: ```
74: 
75: CPU0/CP为0，CPU1/AP为1。UART0的组内index为9，因此：
76: 
77: | 本端 | 方向 | 发送channel | 接收报文中的channel |
78: | --- | --- | ---: | ---: |
79: | AP/OpenVela | CPU1 -> CPU0 | `0x19` | `0x49` |
80: | CP/Armino | CPU0 -> CPU1 | `0x49` | `0x19` |
81: 
82: 参考：
83: 
84: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h:32-44,53,77-96`
85: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h:29-41,49,64-83`
86: 
87: 不得将`0x19`和`0x49`理解为两个独立UART，也不得用IPC `0x10`、PWC `0x12/0x42`或`MB_CHNL_LOG`承载UART字节流。
88: 
89: ### 3.2 Mailbox V2 envelope
90: 
91: MBOX0硬件FIFO中的两个data word是：
92: 
93: | FIFO word | 含义 |
94: | --- | --- |
95: | `data[0]` | 发送端稳定16字节message的32位地址 |
96: | `data[1]` | 固定为16 |
97: 
98: 接收端根据硬件SID确认源CPU，再复制16字节message。AP接收的message地址来自CP拥有的稳定SRAM，CP接收的地址来自AP拥有的稳定SRAM。不能让FIFO引用栈变量，也不能在对端复制前复用或改写该slot。
99: 
100: ### 3.3 16字节message header
101: 
102: word0布局固定如下：
103: 
104: ```text
105: bit[7:0]   cmd
106: bit[11:8]  state
107: bit[15:12] ctrl
108: bit[23:16] tx_seq
109: bit[31:24] logical_chnl
110: ```
111: 
112: `ctrl`定义：
113: 
114: | 位 | 名称 | 语义 |
115: | ---: | --- | --- |
116: | 0 | `CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX` | 1表示transport ACK，0表示command |
117: | 1 | `CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX` | 无ACK同步发送；正式UART普通路径不使用 |
118: | 2 | `CHNL_CTRL_RESET` | transport重同步 |
119: 
120: `state bit0`为`CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL`。ACK必须至少匹配`source/destination + logical_chnl + tx_seq + cmd`，不匹配的ACK只能计为stale/bad ACK，不能释放当前事务。
121: 
122: ### 3.4 MB_UART message布局
123: 
124: 协议运行于ARM32 little-endian。不得在OpenVela实现中继续依赖编译器bitfield，使用显式mask/shift和定宽字段。
125: 
126: DATA/STATE command为16字节：
127: 
128: | offset | 大小 | 字段 |
129: | ---: | ---: | --- |
130: | 0 | 1 | `cmd`：DATA=0，STATE=1 |
131: | 1 | 1 | state/ctrl，发送command时初始为0 |
132: | 2 | 1 | transport sequence |
133: | 3 | 1 | logical channel |
134: | 4 | 4 | DATA交换buffer地址；STATE为0 |
135: | 8 | 2 | DATA有效长度1..128；STATE为0 |
136: | 10 | 1 | bit0=`uart_rts`，其余必须0 |
137: | 11 | 1 | `crc8`，当前兼容值为0 |
138: | 12 | 4 | 保留，必须清0 |
139: 
140: ACK为同一个16字节slot的响应语义：
141: 
142: | offset | 含义 |
143: | ---: | --- |
144: | 0..3 | 原cmd、state，加ACK ctrl、sequence和channel |
145: | 4 bit0 | 接收端当前`uart_rts` |
146: | 4 bit1 | `uart_tx_fail`，本DATA整包未接收 |
147: | 4 bit7:2 | 0 |
148: | 5..15 | 0 |
149: 
150: 所有command和ACK结构在构造前必须`memset(..., 0, 16)`，避免原厂实现中offset 12..15栈残留和ACK尾部旧数据泄漏。这是AP/CP同步升级后的正式ABI要求：当前原厂CP command确实可能带非零栈残留，因此CP清零修复必须先于AP启用严格保留字段拒绝策略，不能只升级AP。
151: 
152: ### 3.5 UART0交换区和所有权
153: 
154: 项目RAM布局固定预留：
155: 
156: ```text
157: SWAP = 0x2809f800..0x2809ffff, size 0x800
158: ```
159: 
160: 来自：
161: 
162: - `bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv:6-10`
163: - 生成的`ram_regions.h`中`CONFIG_SWAP_ADDR=0x2809f800`、`CONFIG_SWAP_SIZE=0x800`
164: 
165: 每个支持共享payload的logical channel占`0x200`字节，顺序为HW_CTRL、LOG、UART0、UART1。每个方向/CPU slot为128字节。当前CPU0/CPU1 UART0精确映射为：
166: 
167: | 地址 | owner/方向 | AP视角 |
168: | --- | --- | --- |
169: | `0x2809fc00..0x2809fc7f` | CP host_tx[CPU1] | AP RX payload，只读后复制 |
170: | `0x2809fc80..0x2809fcff` | CPU2预留 | AP不得使用 |
171: | `0x2809fd00..0x2809fd7f` | AP host_rx[CPU1] | AP TX payload，ACK前保持不变 |
172: | `0x2809fd80..0x2809fdff` | CPU2预留 | AP不得使用 |
173: 
174: OpenVela linker必须新增独立`SWAP` memory region并标记为`NOLOAD`。当前构建顺序是先构建OpenVela、后构建SMP，OpenVela不能读取尚未生成的CP `ram_regions.h`；单一来源固定为比赛仓已提交的`external/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv`。增加预构建生成/校验脚本，由该CSV同时生成或核对OpenVela board header和linker fragment；最终SMP构建后再与Armino生成的`CONFIG_SWAP_ADDR/SIZE`自动比较。不能维护两套无校验硬编码。
175: 
176: 不能把SWAP并入AP heap，不能由AP启动代码清零整个SWAP，也不能在AP `.bss`另建一个“看起来等价”的交换buffer。
177: 
178: 首版在`bk7258_start.c`增加显式共享MPU region，并先读取MPU `TYPE.DREGION`确认region预算：CP普通RAM中的envelope窗口为shareable、non-cacheable、RO/XN；CP拥有的UART0 RX payload `0x2809fc00..0x2809fc7f`为RO/XN；AP拥有的UART0 TX payload `0x2809fd00..0x2809fd7f`为RW/XN。当前MPU使用`PRIVDEFENA`，未覆盖地址对privileged内核仍可访问，因此CPU2预留slot只能由MB_UART软件白名单/API禁止访问，不能声称由MPU隔离。
179: 
180: 若硬件region数不足以按128字节拆分，才允许将整个SWAP设为RW/XN，但必须记录这是硬件粒度降级并继续以软件白名单强制方向所有权，不能把CP普通RAM扩大为RW。若未来要求硬件阻止访问预留slot，必须关闭`PRIVDEFENA`并完整映射所有必要内存，这不属于本轮UART移植。
181: 
182: 若后续启用D-cache，所有ownership交接统一由共享内存API执行：发布前clean + DMB，读取前invalidate + DMB，ACK后才复用；cache line为32字节，操作必须向外对齐且不能误刷相邻owner数据。

185: 
186: ### 4.1 AP侧
187: 
188: 当前`bk7258_mailbox_channel.c`具备基础`0x19/0x49`分派、AP TX ring和transport ACK匹配，但存在以下交付阻断项：

260: ## 6. AP Mailbox V2 transport设计
261: 
262: ### 6.1 物理层
263: 
264: CPU1只配置自己拥有的channel 1：FIFO start=2、length=3，接收IRQ source 63映射到NuttX IRQ79。物理层初始化必须在`up_initialize()`可使用NuttX IRQ API后、board late逻辑服务前完成。
265: 
266: ISR固定执行：
267: 
268: 1. 读取并累计`wrerr/rderr/wrfull`等W1C错误状态。
269: 2. 循环读取FIFO直到empty，不能每次中断只取一个。
270: 3. 校验SID为CPU0、length为16、地址4字节对齐、`address + 16`无溢出且位于CP RAM `0x28064000..0x2809f6ff`。当前CP `mbox0_adapter.c`的envelope slot是可随链接变化的普通`.bss mailbox_buff`，并没有固定地址ABI或32字节对齐，AP不能写死更小窗口。
271: 4. 立即复制到AP-owned RX descriptor queue，随后上层处理；不能长期持有CP message指针。
272: 5. 若RX descriptor queue或ACK资源不足，停止继续drain并保留中断，不能读出后无ACK丢弃。
273: 
274: 初始化时不再盲目drain。应先安装logical callback和RX/ACK资源，再处理已有FIFO。无法识别的有效command也必须返回`COM_FAIL` ACK。
275: 
276: ### 6.2 稳定transaction slot
277: 
278: 每个CPU0物理方向同时只允许一个command in-flight，以兼容原厂physical BUSY模型。实现至少准备：
279: 
280: - 每个logical channel一个16字节pending command副本。
281: - 一个独立16字节active slot；发送后直到ACK/reset完成不可修改。
282: - 至少3个AP-owned ACK slots和一个ACK FIFO，容量不小于硬件RX FIFO深度。
283: - AP新建的active/ACK message slot按32字节对齐并位于AP RAM白名单；接收CP envelope只要求原厂ABI的4字节对齐和CP RAM范围。payload SWAP另行精确校验。
284: 
285: slot释放事件必须明确，因为硬件FIFO保存的是地址而不是16字节值：
286: 
287: - command正常收到匹配ACK后可释放。
288: - command timeout后转为quarantine；发送RESET不释放它。RESET和随后STATE使用各自独立稳定slot。只有STATE收到成功ACK，利用同一AP->CP FIFO顺序证明旧command、RESET和STATE都已被复制后，才一起释放旧command和RESET slot。STATE失败时保持quarantine，直到MBOX硬件重新初始化，不能因进入DOWN就复用。
289: - ACK slot不能以“收到对端下一条command”为释放证据，因为对端timeout后可能绕过旧ACK继续发送。只有本端随后一个同方向、需要ACK的普通事务收到成功ACK，才能证明排在它之前的本端ACK envelope已经被对端复制。
290: - ACK pool达到高水位（建议已占用2/3）时，transport必须立即在所有待发ACK之后调度一个独立稳定slot的STATE probe。probe收到成功ACK后，按本端FIFO发送顺序批量释放排在它之前的ACK slots；probe失败则进入DOWN并保持这些slot quarantine。不能依赖heartbeat或应用数据未来恰好出现。
291: - RESET和SYNC都没有自己的ACK。RESET由紧随其后的成功STATE释放；通用SYNC使用独立slot，并在下一个同方向普通事务成功完成后释放。专用slot尚未释放时再次调用同类旁路发送返回`-EBUSY`，不得有限轮转后覆盖。
292: - ACK在DOWN、ABORTING、PROBING和QUIESCING状态下仍是最高发送优先级；状态变化不能免除已经接收的对端command所需ACK。
293: 
294: CP `mbox0_adapter.c`也按相同原则分别管理command、ACK、RESET和SYNC slot，禁止现有“每次发送无条件轮转两个slot”的做法。
295: 
296: 调度优先级保持原厂“logical index越小优先级越高”：HW_CTRL、PWC优先于UART0，避免日志压力阻塞heartbeat和电源命令。ACK永远高于新command。
297: 
298: ### 6.3 ACK和超时
299: 
300: 收到ACK后完整检查：
301: 
302: ```text
303: SID == CPU0
304: ACK_BOX == 1
305: logical_channel == active.channel
306: tx_seq == active.seq
307: cmd == active.cmd
308: RESET/state/reserved组合合法
309: ```
310: 
311: 匹配成功后才释放active slot并调用logical completion。UART completion再根据`COM_FAIL`和`uart_tx_fail`决定成功或失败。
312: 
313: 超时不得直接修改active buffer并重发。第一版策略：
314: 
315: 1. 200 ms无ACK，标记当前transaction失败并保留错误快照。
316: 2. 停止所有普通新TX，向CPU0发送原厂兼容RESET abort通知；RESET使用独立稳定slot。
317: 3. RESET是`ACK_BOX|RESET`单向通知，CP空闲时会忽略，不返回RESET ACK。AP发送成功后进入PROBING，并用独立slot发送后续MB_UART STATE；不能等待不存在的RESET ACK，也不能复用被abort事务的slot。
318: 4. abort发出或收到peer reset后，所有pending非幂等PWC请求以`-ECONNRESET`完成，不自动重放。
319: 5. UART chunk可保留在本地TX ring，重新交换STATE后最多重发一次；日志允许重复风险时也必须通过计数可见。建议默认不自动重发已经可能被对端消费但ACK丢失的chunk，而是丢弃该chunk并累计`tx_unknown`，避免终端出现重复字符。
320: 6. RESET envelope发送失败或后续STATE仍无ACK则link进入DOWN，heartbeat/ready逻辑可检测并执行既定降级或复位策略。
321: 
322: 8位sequence在每次新transaction递增，0可自然出现；本地abort后建立新的软件epoch。不能仅靠wire sequence解决跨reset的极晚ACK。链路状态统一为`DOWN/ABORTING/PROBING/READY/QUIESCING`：ABORTING不发新的普通command，PROBING只发STATE普通command，但所有状态始终优先发送已欠的ACK。
323: 
324: 只有STATE ACK同时满足channel/sequence/cmd匹配、`COM_FAIL==0`、`uart_tx_fail==0`、保留字段合法并成功取得peer RTS时，才能从PROBING进入READY。匹配但带`COM_FAIL`的ACK表示CP尚未open MB_UART0，应在有界退避后继续探测，达到总超时后进入DOWN。
325: 
326: ### 6.4 reset方向
327: 
328: AP transport初始化完成后主动向CP发送一次原厂RESET abort通知，作用是让CP结束可能指向上一个AP boot的in-flight transaction。它不是双向握手：AP不等待响应，而是随后发送STATE探测。收到CP RESET时：
329: 
330: - 对当前active事务生成`-ECONNRESET` completion，但其slot转入quarantine而不复用。反方向收到peer RESET不能证明本端目标FIFO中的旧envelope已经被复制。
331: - 终止本端active/pending outgoing事务并清理其physical busy和peer RTS已知状态；不得清理已经接收且尚未发送的ACK queue。
332: - 保留尚未提交的本地UART TX ring，丢弃不完整AP RX chunk。
333: - 不返回RESET ACK；按原厂语义完成本端abort，再由MB_UART STATE/ACK恢复流控。
334: 
335: CP侧原厂channel层已有处理AP reset并将旧事务以`COM_FAIL`完成的基础逻辑；CP空闲时会直接忽略RESET。上板前需验证当前CP分支未被其他补丁破坏。
336: 
337: quarantine slot只能由后续同方向STATE成功ACK释放，或由明确清空AP->CP目标channel/FIFO的CP侧重初始化、全系统复位释放。AP只重初始化自己的channel 1、IRQ或RX FIFO不能证明CPU0目标FIFO中的旧地址已消失，不得作为释放条件。
338: 
339: ## 7. AP MB_UART0设计
340: 
341: ### 7.1 控制块
342: 
343: AP MB_UART0至少维护：
344: 
345: - `tx_ring`：建议4096或8192字节，用于console/syslog burst，单producer假设不可成立，写入需NuttX spinlock保护。
346: - `rx_ring`：257字节，实际容量256，与原厂语义一致。
347: - 固定AP TX SWAP地址`0x2809fd00`，固定AP RX SWAP地址`0x2809fc00`。
348: - `tx_inflight_len`、`tx_command`、`tx_busy`和`state_pending`。
349: - `local_rts`：AP RX流控；0允许CP发送，1暂停。
350: - `peer_rts`：来自CP command/ACK；0允许AP发送，1暂停。
351: - `rx_irq_enabled`：NuttX serial upper-half当前是否允许接收。
352: - link状态：DOWN/ABORTING/PROBING/READY/QUIESCING。
353: - 分项统计：write/drop、DATA/STATE、overflow、bad pointer/length/CRC、remote fail、ACK timeout、reset、high watermark持续时间。
354: 
355: ### 7.2 AP发送
356: 
357: `write()`只把实际可容纳的字节数写入TX ring并返回该字节数，不返回“部分写入后-ENOSPC”这种不可恢复语义。NuttX serial `send()`每次一个字符，syslog bulk write则循环分片并准确报告短写。
358: 
359: 发送条件：link READY、无MB_UART transaction in-flight、`peer_rts==0`、TX ring非空。每次最多取128字节复制到`0x2809fd00`，构造DATA：
360: 
361: ```text
362: cmd_buff     = 0x2809fd00
363: cmd_data_len = min(tx_count, 128)
364: uart_rts     = local_rts
365: crc8         = 0
366: reserved     = 0
367: ```
368: 
369: 与当前本地代码不同，TX ring读指针在成功ACK后才推进。收到`COM_FAIL`或`uart_tx_fail`时不推进；先记录失败并按reset策略处理，避免原厂“提交logical write即消费，ACK失败静默丢失”的缺陷。
370: 
371: 若没有数据但`local_rts`发生变化，发送STATE。DATA ACK本身已携带最新RTS，因此在DATA处理中可合并待发STATE，但不能丢掉最终状态变化。
372: 
373: ### 7.3 AP接收
374: 
375: 收到channel `0x49` command后先验证header，再处理：
376: 
377: DATA必须同时满足：
378: 
379: - `cmd_buff == 0x2809fc00`，不接受“位于SWAP任意位置”或普通CP RAM中的任意指针。
380: - `1 <= cmd_data_len <= 128`，地址加法无溢出。
381: - `crc8 == 0`且保留位为0。
382: - 当前link允许接收。
383: 
384: 接收前执行共享内存acquire/cache invalidate。只有RX ring剩余空间大于等于整包长度时才整包复制；否则整包不复制，设置sticky overflow并在ACK中置`uart_tx_fail=1`。绝不部分接收后报告失败，否则发送端无法确定消费边界。
385: 
386: 无论DATA还是STATE，都更新`peer_rts=command.uart_rts`。响应ACK包含最新`local_rts`。成功DATA复制后触发NuttX RX处理；ISR内不运行NSH、不格式化日志。
387: 
388: ### 7.4 RTS/CTS水位
389: 
390: 保持原厂兼容阈值：
391: 
392: - RX ring总数组257字节、容量256。
393: - 剩余空间`<=128`时设置`local_rts=1`，确保已经在途的一个最大128字节chunk仍有明确处理结果。
394: - 应用读取后，occupancy低于102字节时设置`local_rts=0`并发送STATE，提供滞回避免状态抖动。
395: - `peer_rts=1`时AP禁止新DATA，但仍允许必要的ACK、RESET和本端STATE。
396: 
397: 由于NuttX还有一层`uart_dev_s.recv` ring，MB_UART RX ring的RTS必须根据“MB_UART ring可用空间”管理；`uart_recvchars()`应及时搬运到NuttX ring。新的`BK7258_MB_UART0_CONSOLE` Kconfig必须`select OTHER_UART_SERIALDRIVER`、`select OTHER_SERIAL_CONSOLE`和`select SERIAL_IFLOWCONTROL`，不能只在defconfig手写隐藏symbol；`OTHER_SERIAL_CONSOLE`再通过NuttX console choice选择`SERIAL_CONSOLE`。
398: 
399: 第一版同时启用`SERIAL_IFLOWCONTROL_WATERMARKS`，upper/lower watermark固定为75%/25%。NuttX upper-half到达75%时停止继续搬运并保持/拉高MB_UART RTS；低于25%后重新调用搬运并释放RTS。若不启watermark选项，NuttX只会在full/empty回调，不能声称具备本文的高低水位行为。
400: 
401: ### 7.5 NuttX serial接入
402: 
403: 正式设备不再冒充物理UART1：
404: 
405: - 注册`/dev/console`和`/dev/ttyMB0`到同一个Mailbox UART device。
406: - 删除`CONFIG_UART1_SERIALDRIVER`、`CONFIG_UART1_SERIAL_CONSOLE`和`BK7258_AP_UART1`误导配置。
407: - 新增板级`BK7258_MB_UART0_CONSOLE`选择，并让NuttX console宏映射到该虚拟设备。
408: - 不执行任何UART1 clock、pinmux或GPIO0/1配置。
409: 
410: `uart_ops_s`实现：
411: 
412: | op | 行为 |
413: | --- | --- |
414: | `setup/attach` | 确认MB_UART已注册callback，不能重复初始化physical mailbox |
415: | `shutdown/detach` | 普通console关闭不销毁全局heartbeat共用transport |
416: | `receive` | 从MB_UART RX ring弹出1字节，status返回overflow/parity sticky快照 |
417: | `rxavailable` | 查询MB_UART RX ring非空 |
418: | `rxint` | 保存enable；enable时投递RX worker或调用受控`uart_recvchars()` |
419: | `send` | 写一个字节到MB_UART TX ring；只在`txready`为true时由upper-half调用 |
420: | `txint` | enable时调用`uart_xmitchars()`，ACK/CTS恢复后再次kick |
421: | `txready` | link ready、TX ring有空间；不要求物理channel当前idle |
422: | `txempty` | NuttX xmit ring、MB_UART TX ring和active DATA都为空 |
423: | `rxflowcontrol` | upper-half高水位时拉高local RTS，恢复时拉低并kick RX |
424: 
425: Mailbox ISR只将DATA复制到MB_UART RX ring并post一个高优先级worker/semaphore。worker调用`uart_recvchars()`，避免在硬件Mailbox ISR里进入完整TTY路径。TX ACK或peer RTS从1变0时，同样由worker调用`uart_xmitchars()`。
426: 
427: ### 7.6 syslog和early putc
428: 
429: - transport ready前允许写入一个小型有界early TX ring；满后丢弃并计数，不阻塞启动。
430: - transport ready后由MB_UART worker排空early数据。
431: - bulk syslog按`size_t`循环，每次传入不超过`UINT16_MAX`，返回实际接受字节数；不能无条件返回原长度。
432: - `sc_force`和`arm_lowputc`仍只能best-effort，不宣称IRQ关闭时可靠。可提供有界flush，例如等待不超过20 ms；禁止永久等待ACK。
433: - 避免console和独立syslog backend重复输出同一条日志。最终配置只能有一个主syslog路径。
434: 
435: ## 8. CP UART0双向桥设计
436: 
437: ### 8.1 唯一MB_UART0 owner
438: 
439: CP只调用一次`bk_mb_uart_dev_init(MB_UART0)`。现有`ap_uart0_log_init()`扩展为统一bridge：
440: 
441: - 注册MB_UART RX callback，唤醒AP输出worker。
442: - 注册MB_UART TX callback，唤醒PC输入发送worker。
443: - 使用有界CP->AP TX ring，建议512或1024字节。
444: - worker根据`bk_mb_uart_write_ready()`处理部分写入，调用`bk_mb_uart_write()`，直到队列为空或peer RTS暂停。
445: - 暴露drop、partial write、MB_UART status、mode switch和last error统计。
446: 
447: 不得为RX和TX分别初始化两次MB_UART0，也不得让日志服务和console服务分别open channel。
448: 
449: ### 8.2 AP输出模式
450: 
451: 提供两个输出策略，但共享同一个MB_UART RX：
452: 
453: 1. `LOG`模式：保持当前按行添加`ap0: `、50 ms半行flush和有限重试，适合AP后台日志。
454: 2. `RAW_CONSOLE`模式：不添加前缀、不等待换行，收到后立即通过CP shell TX queue输出，保证`nsh>`、echo、退格和ANSI字节透明。
455: 
456: 进入AP交互console时切为RAW；退出后恢复LOG。模式切换前先flush旧的半行缓存，防止旧日志与prompt拼接。CP自身异步日志仍可能插入AP终端，第一版应在RAW模式下抑制非关键CP日志或明确串行化，至少不能从两个线程直接写物理UART0。
457: 
458: ### 8.3 UART0输入所有权
459: 
460: CP shell已拥有物理UART0 RX ISR和buffer，因此路由点放在`shell_task.c`读取UART字节之后、执行`handle_shell_input()`之前。状态固定为：
461: 
462: ```text
463: CP_CLI       所有输入由CP CLI处理
464: AP_CONSOLE   原始输入转发给MB_UART0，CP CLI不再解析
465: ```
466: 
467: 上电默认`CP_CLI`。只有满足以下条件才允许进入`AP_CONSOLE`：
468: 
469: - AP已发送Mailbox RESET abort通知并完成STATE/ACK链路探测。
470: - AP已发送IPC power-up和PWC boot ready。
471: - CP bridge确认MB_UART0可写。
472: 
473: CP CLI新增明确命令，例如`ap_console open`。命令handler只设置`SWITCH_TO_AP_PENDING`，不能立即修改owner：先等待当前命令响应和CP TX queue flush，抑制尾随`cp>`，原子清理`cmd_line_buf`、BK_REG/AT/escape解析状态并通过`SHELL_IO_CTRL_RX_RESET`清物理UART RX残留，之后才进入AP_CONSOLE并打印一次切换提示。
474: 
475: AP_CONSOLE保留一个本地退出转义，建议使用行首`Ctrl-]`后跟`.`；解析器只在行首识别完整转义，其他字节原样转发。退出时进入`SWITCH_TO_CP_PENDING`，丢弃未完成转义、停止接收新AP输入、清理或明确丢弃尚未发送的bridge TX，flush AP RAW输出后再恢复CP parser和prompt。退出转义由CP消费，不发送给NSH。
476: 
477: 禁止把同一字节同时广播给CP CLI和AP NSH，否则两个shell会同时echo/执行。下载工具、ATE和bootloader阶段不进入该状态机，维持原UART0 owner。
478: 
479: ### 8.4 PC输入发送
480: 
481: 在AP_CONSOLE状态，CP shell现有UART RX路径读取到原始字节后：
482: 
483: 1. 先运行最小退出转义状态机。
484: 2. 非转义字节写入CP->AP bridge ring。
485: 3. bridge worker根据MB_UART write-ready发送；不得在UART ISR中调用可能触发Mailbox发送和复杂锁的接口。
486: 4. ring满时优先通过MB_UART RTS自然回压；物理UART0无硬件流控，仍可能在高速粘贴时丢字，必须计数并在退出RAW后报告。
487: 5. 可选的软件输入限速按115200估算，但不得sleep在UART ISR；只能由worker分批发送。
488: 
489: AP link down/reset时CP自动退出AP_CONSOLE，清理未发送输入并恢复CP_CLI，避免用户被锁死在无响应终端。为使该行为可实现，CP `mailbox_channel.c`必须新增peer RESET/physical timeout通知，IPC heartbeat/PWC recovery也要向bridge发布AP_DOWN事件；不能从`bk_mb_uart_get_status()`推断link状态。bridge通过统一event callback处理`AP_READY/AP_DOWN/PEER_RESET`，并在事件中只唤醒worker，不直接操作shell队列。
490: 
491: ### 8.5 CP原厂驱动最小加固
492: 
493: 在不改变线协议的前提下同步修复：
494: 
495: - `mb_uart_init()`第二个NULL检查应为`rx_xchg_buff`。
496: - DATA RX校验`cmd_buff`必须等于本端预期`rx_xchg_buff`，长度1..128。
497: - 所有command/response先清零保留字段。
498: - bridge必须正确处理`bk_mb_uart_write()`部分写和`bk_mb_uart_get_status()`。
499: - `mailbox_channel.c`向bridge暴露peer reset/timeout通知；收到AP reset时即使CP physical TX为空也必须发布事件，而不是只记fault后静默返回。
500: 
501: 原厂驱动在logical write成功时提前推进TX ring，远端`uart_tx_fail`时不会回滚。若不重写CP mb_uart状态机，CP输入可靠性仍低于AP改进实现。正式交付建议把CP TX也改为“ACK成功后推进ring”，但这会扩大原厂代码改动。实施可分两步：先完成兼容双向链路并测出失败路径，再将该加固作为进入压力验收前的必做项，而不是长期保留静默丢输入行为。
502: 
503: ## 9. 启动、ready和恢复时序
504: 
505: ### 9.1 CP时序
506: 
507: ```text
508: CP bootloader/download UART0保持原行为
509:   -> CP UART0 115200 8N1和shell初始化
510:   -> Mailbox V2 physical/channel初始化
511:   -> MB_UART0唯一bridge init，注册RX/TX callback
512:   -> 默认CP_CLI模式
513:   -> 启动AP
514:   -> 等待AP IPC power-up
515:   -> 等待AP PWC boot ready
516:   -> 允许用户执行ap_console open
517: ```
518: 
519: ### 9.2 AP时序
520: 
521: ```text
522: CPU1 reset
523:   -> MPU/vector/基础NuttX启动
524:   -> 注册有界early syslog，不访问UART1
525:   -> up_initialize调用arm_serialinit
526:   -> arm_serialinit在uart_register前初始化MBOX0 IRQ79和RX资源
527:   -> 初始化logical transport、ACK pool和MB_UART0 rings/SWAP/callback
528:   -> 创建Mailbox/UART RX/TX worker；允许其在调度器运行后启动
529:   -> 发送单向RESET abort通知，不等待RESET ACK
530:   -> 异步发送STATE(local_rts=0)，arm_serialinit不阻塞等待
531:   -> 注册/dev/console和/dev/ttyMB0
532:   -> board late在worker已运行后有界等待STATE transport ACK
533:   -> 发送IPC power-up并确认transport ACK
534:   -> 启动heartbeat和PWC worker
535:   -> 发送PWC boot ready
536:   -> 启动NSH
537: ```
538: 
539: `arm_serialinit()`运行在公共`up_initialize()`中，OS/driver服务可用，但不得依赖用户初始化线程已经运行，因此这里只安装全部资源并异步kick。STATE ACK的有界等待放到board late，此时worker和系统tick已明确运行。
540: 
541: ready门禁新增：MB_UART RX已能整包复制并调用NuttX worker，TX/STATE完成至少一次探测。日志输出失败不能无限阻塞heartbeat；有界失败后记录link状态，并按产品策略决定继续无console运行还是拒绝ready。比赛调试固件建议MB_UART失败时拒绝ready，避免出现“系统似乎启动但唯一console不可用”。
542: 
543: ### 9.3 suspend/resume和重启
544: 
545: 首版若未完整实现Mailbox PM，必须对相关deep sleep投票禁止进入，不能让CP关闭共享资源后AP仍认为link READY。
546: 
547: 实现PM后流程：
548: 
549: - suspend：停止新DATA，等待active有界完成，拉高RTS，发送STATE，保存统计并关闭IRQ route。
550: - resume：重配CPU1 FIFO/IRQ、清W1C错误、发送单向RESET abort通知、用STATE/ACK探测，再恢复DATA。
551: - AP重启：AP主动发送RESET abort通知；CP transport发布PEER_RESET/AP_DOWN事件，bridge将旧AP TX以失败完成并自动退出AP_CONSOLE。
552: - CP重启：AP ACK timeout进入ABORTING/DOWN，不继续写旧payload；CP恢复后重新执行RESET abort和STATE/ACK探测。
553:

591: ## 11. 分阶段实施
592: 
593: ### 阶段A：协议和内存固化
594: 
595: 1. 在AP代码中定义显式wire结构、mask和static assert。
596: 2. 先在CP `mb_uart_driver.c`完成command/ACK全量清零、payload指针/长度校验和NULL检查；AP严格检查保留字段以此为前置条件。
597: 3. linker加入SWAP，不清零、不进heap；构建map确认`0x2809f800..0x2809ffff`唯一。
598: 4. 写主机侧单元测试验证channel编码、header pack/unpack、地址溢出和精确payload白名单。
599: 
600: 出口：离线测试能精确生成与原厂一致的16字节DATA/STATE/ACK。
601: 
602: ### 阶段B：transport可靠化
603: 
604: 1. 修复MBOX0初始化盲目drain和错误状态。
605: 2. AP实现active command、ACK稳定slot/queue、完整ACK关联和单向reset abort；CP adapter同步改为command/ACK专用稳定slot。
606: 3. 先用HW_CTRL/PWC回归，不接console大流量。
607: 
608: 出口：power-up、heartbeat和PWC ready都收到ACK；注入FIFO full/stale ACK不会永久busy。
609: 
610: ### 阶段C：AP MB_UART全双工
611: 
612: 1. 加入固定SWAP TX/RX、DATA/STATE和RTS/CTS。
613: 2. 完成NuttX serial RX和`uart_recvchars()` worker。
614: 3. 设备改名`ttyMB0`并移除UART1配置。
615: 
616: 出口：用CP测试任务调用`bk_mb_uart_write(MB_UART0, "help\n", 5)`可驱动NSH，AP输出可返回CP。
617: 
618: ### 阶段D：CP UART0桥
619: 
620: 1. 扩展唯一MB_UART0 bridge和RAW/LOG输出。
621: 2. 在CP shell现有输入owner中加入模式切换，不注册第二个UART ISR。
622: 3. 加入延迟生效的owner切换、退出转义、transport/heartbeat事件驱动的link-down自动回退和统计命令。
623: 
624: 出口：单根Type-C上可从CP CLI进入AP NSH、交互、退出并恢复CP CLI。
625: 
626: ### 阶段E：恢复和压力
627: 
628: 1. AP/CP reset、ACK timeout、FIFO full、RX overflow、RTS持续和高速粘贴故障注入。
629: 2. heartbeat/PWC/日志/输入并发。
630: 3. PM未完成则验证sleep vote确实阻止破坏link；完成后验证suspend/resume重握手。
631: 
632: 出口：满足第12节全部验收标准后，才删除旧output-only兼容代码和UART1命名。
633: 
634: ## 12. 测试和验收矩阵
635: 
636: ### 12.1 构建和静态检查
637: 
638: - OpenVela AP `-Werror`构建通过；最终SMP `all-app.bin`完整构建通过。
639: - map中SWAP地址、大小、NOLOAD和AP heap边界正确；AP TX/RX指针分别固定为`0x2809fd00/0x2809fc00`。
640: - GPIO0/1没有UART1 pinmux，二进制无物理UART1 console初始化。
641: - CP覆盖副本与`bk_avdk_smp`目标文件`cmp -s`一致。
642: - 静态扫描不存在ISR内sleep、无界semaphore wait、printf或直接阻塞UART0输出。
643: 
644: ### 12.2 功能
645: 
646: | 用例 | 预期 |
647: | --- | --- |
648: | CP冷启动 | CP log和CP prompt正常，默认不劫持UART0输入 |
649: | AP启动 | 出现带`ap0:`的OpenVela日志，heartbeat无超时 |
650: | `ap_console open` | 切入RAW，出现`nsh>`且prompt无50 ms按行前缀改写 |
651: | NSH输入 | 字母、回车、退格、方向键、Ctrl-C均按TTY语义工作 |
652: | 退出转义 | 不传给AP，恢复CP prompt和LOG模式 |
653: | AP长输出 | 大于128字节正确分片、顺序一致、无覆盖 |
654: | PC高速粘贴 | RTS发生且系统不死锁；超出物理能力时drop计数可见 |
655: | `poll/read` | `/dev/console`和`/dev/ttyMB0`的POLLIN、blocking/nonblocking语义正确 |
656: 
657: ### 12.3 故障和并发
658: 
659: - 注入非法envelope地址、长度、SID、channel、payload地址、129字节长度和非零保留位，均拒绝且计数；有效command收到`COM_FAIL` ACK，不拖死CP physical channel。
660: - ACK FIFO满时不覆盖旧ACK；停止drain或受控恢复。
661: - 丢失DATA ACK后不原地改写in-flight slot，不出现无限重复字符。
662: - stale/wrong cmd/wrong sequence ACK不能释放当前事务。
663: - RX ring不足时整包拒绝，`uart_tx_fail=1`，不部分注入NSH。
664: - AP重启期间CP自动退出AP_CONSOLE；重启后旧输入和旧输出不重放。
665: - CP重启后AP进入DOWN并重新执行RESET abort和STATE/ACK探测，无永久`peer_rts=1`。
666: - 连续10 MiB AP输出、1 MiB双向随机字节和1小时交互期间，heartbeat、PWC和CP UART0不失效。
667: - UART压力下HW_CTRL/PWC优先于UART0，ready和heartbeat延迟有上界。
668: 
669: ### 12.4 最低可观察结果
670: 
671: ```text
672: CP boot...
673: ap0: OpenVela mailbox uart ready
674: cp> ap_console open
675: nsh> uname -a
676: ...
677: nsh>                         # 行首 Ctrl-] .
678: AP console closed
679: cp>
680: ```
681: 
682: 统计命令至少输出：link/mode、peer/local RTS、TX/RX ring occupancy、active channel/seq/cmd、DATA/STATE计数、drop、overflow、remote fail、bad envelope/payload/ACK、timeout和reset次数。
683: 
684: ## 13. 风险和明确决策
685: 
686: 1. **唯一物理UART复用风险**：UART0同时服务下载、CP shell、CP log和AP console。通过运行期显式owner切换解决，不在bootloader阶段透明桥接。
687: 2. **原厂协议无端到端可靠序号**：transport sequence只关联单次message，ACK丢失后无法判断对端是否已消费。正式策略优先避免重复输入，记录`tx_unknown`并reset，而不是盲目重发。
688: 3. **物理UART无硬件流控**：Mailbox RTS只能限制CP到AP交换，不能让CH340停止已经到达CP UART FIFO的数据。高速粘贴仍需有界CP ring和可见drop。
689: 4. **panic日志限制**：MB_UART依赖中断，不能冒充真正polling UART。验收只要求正常调度和可屏蔽短临界区下工作，不承诺hard-fault关中断后的完整日志。
690: 5. **SMP并发**：当前AP为单核时可用local IRQ lock；正式启用CPU2前，transport和ring必须切换为NuttX SMP-safe spinlock并明确CPU1 owner或跨核代理。
691: 6. **cache**：首版SWAP non-cacheable。任何启cache改动必须两端同时验证，不能只加一个DMB就宣称安全。
692: 7. **CP改动维护成本**：完整输入owner必须修改shell路径，而不是只改`driver.c`。这些文件必须纳入external覆盖和构建说明，否则下一次清理构建会丢失功能。

48: #define AP_UART0_LOG_RETRY_MAX 3
49: #define AP_UART0_LOG_RETRY_MS  10
50: #define AP_UART0_LOG_FLUSH_MS  50
51: 
52: static beken_semaphore_t s_ap_uart0_log_sem;
53: static beken_thread_t s_ap_uart0_log_thread;

56: static void ap_uart0_log_output(const uint8_t *line, u16 length)
57: {
58: 	static const uint8_t prefix[] = "ap0: ";
59: 	uint8_t output[sizeof(prefix) - 1 + AP_UART0_LOG_LINE_SIZE];
60: 	u16 output_length;
61: 	u8 retry;
62: 
63: 	memcpy(output, prefix, sizeof(prefix) - 1);
64: 	memcpy(output + sizeof(prefix) - 1, line, length);
65: 	output_length = sizeof(prefix) - 1 + length;
66: 
67: 	for (retry = 0; retry < AP_UART0_LOG_RETRY_MAX; retry++)
68: 	{
69: 		if (shell_log_raw_data(output, output_length))
70: 		{
71: 			return;
72: 		}
73: 
74: 		rtos_delay_milliseconds(AP_UART0_LOG_RETRY_MS);
75: 	}
76: 
77: 	s_ap_uart0_log_write_fail++;
78: }
79: 
80: static void ap_uart0_log_rx(void *param)
81: {
82: 	(void)param;
83: 	(void)rtos_set_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem);
84: }
85: 
86: static void ap_uart0_log_task(beken_thread_arg_t arg)
87: {
88: 	uint8_t input[MB_CHNL_BUFF_LEN];
89: 	uint8_t line[AP_UART0_LOG_LINE_SIZE];
90: 	u16 line_length = 0;
91: 
92: 	(void)arg;
93: 	for (;;)
94: 	{
95: 		u16 input_length;
96: 		u16 index;
97: 		bk_err_t ret;
98: 
99: 		ret = rtos_get_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem,
100: 						 line_length ? AP_UART0_LOG_FLUSH_MS : BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER);
101: 		if (ret == kTimeoutErr)
102: 		{
103: 			ap_uart0_log_output(line, line_length);
104: 			line_length = 0;
105: 			continue;
106: 		}
107: 
108: 		do
109: 		{
110: 			input_length = bk_mb_uart_read(MB_UART0, input, sizeof(input));
111: 			for (index = 0; index < input_length; index++)
112: 			{
113: 				line[line_length++] = input[index];
114: 				if (input[index] == '\n' || line_length == sizeof(line))
115: 				{
116: 					ap_uart0_log_output(line, line_length);
117: 					line_length = 0;
118: 				}
119: 			}
120: 		} while (input_length != 0);
121: 	}
122: }
123: 
124: static bk_err_t ap_uart0_log_init(void)
125: {
126: 	bk_err_t ret;
127: 
128: 	ret = rtos_init_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem, 1);
129: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
130: 	{
131: 		return ret;
132: 	}
133: 
134: 	ret = rtos_create_thread(&s_ap_uart0_log_thread,
135: 					 BEKEN_DEFAULT_WORKER_PRIORITY,
136: 					 "ap_uart0_log", ap_uart0_log_task, 2048, NULL);
137: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
138: 	{
139: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem);
140: 		return ret;
141: 	}
142: 
143: 	ret = bk_mb_uart_dev_init(MB_UART0);
144: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
145: 	{
146: 		rtos_delete_thread(&s_ap_uart0_log_thread);
147: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem);
148: 		return ret;
149: 	}
150: 
151: 	ret = bk_mb_uart_register_rx_isr(MB_UART0, ap_uart0_log_rx, NULL);
152: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
153: 	{
154: 		bk_mb_uart_dev_deinit(MB_UART0);
155: 		rtos_delete_thread(&s_ap_uart0_log_thread);
156: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem);
157: 		return ret;
158: 	}
159: 
160: 	/* Drain data that may have arrived between channel open and callback
161: 	 * registration. The binary semaphore intentionally coalesces wakeups. */
162: 	(void)rtos_set_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem);
163: 	return BK_OK;
164: }

137: static u8 cal_crc8_0x31(u8 *data_buf, u16 len)
138: {
139: 	u8    crc = 0x00;

141: #if MB_UART_CRC8_ENABLE

145: 	}
146: #endif
147: 
148: 	return (crc);
149: }

179: static void rx_isr_data_handler(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_uart_cmd_t * uart_cmd)
180: {
181: 	u8      tx_fail = 0;
182: 
183: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx, free_cnt;
184: 
185: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx;
186: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx;
187: 
188: 	if(rd_idx > wr_idx)
189: 	{
190: 		free_cnt = rd_idx - wr_idx - 1;  // always reserved one byte space.
191: 	}
192: 	else
193: 	{
194: 		free_cnt = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - (wr_idx - rd_idx) - 1;
195: 	}
196: 
197: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == uart_cmd->cmd_buff. MUST be true. */
198: 
199: 	if((uart_cmd->cmd_buff == NULL) || (uart_cmd->cmd_data_len == 0))
200: 	{
201: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
202: 	}
203: 
204: 	if(uart_cmd->cmd_data_len > free_cnt)
205: 	{
206: 		chnl_cb->status_overflow = 1;   /* discards all rx-data.  */
207: 		tx_fail = 1;
208: 		
209: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
210: 	}
211: 
212: 	#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
213: 	flush_dcache(uart_cmd->cmd_buff, uart_cmd->cmd_data_len);
214: 	#endif
215: 
216: 	u16    rem_len, cpy_len;
217: 
218: 	cpy_len = uart_cmd->cmd_data_len;
219: 
220: 	if(uart_cmd->crc8 != cal_crc8_0x31((u8 *)uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len))
221: 	{
222: 		chnl_cb->status_parity = 1;   /* discards all rx-data.  */
223: 		tx_fail = 1;
224: 		
225: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
226: 	}
227: 
228: 	if(wr_idx < rd_idx)
229: 	{
230: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len);
231: 		chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx += cpy_len;
232: 	}
233: 	else
234: 	{
235: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - wr_idx;
236: 
237: 		if(rd_idx == 0)
238: 			rem_len -= 1;  // if rx_idx == 0, reserved one byte at tail of the array.
239: 
240: 		if(rem_len > cpy_len)
241: 		{
242: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len);
243: 			chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx += cpy_len;
244: 		}
245: 		else
246: 		{
247: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, rem_len);
248: 
249: 			if(rem_len < cpy_len)
250: 			{
251: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf, uart_cmd->cmd_buff + rem_len, cpy_len - rem_len);
252: 			}
253: 
254: 			chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx = cpy_len - rem_len;
255: 		}
256: 	}
257: 
258: 	free_cnt -= cpy_len;
259: 
260: 	if(chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback != NULL)
261: 	{
262: 		chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->rx_isr_param);
263: 	}
264: 
265: rx_isr_data_xit:
266: 	
267: 	if(free_cnt <= MB_UART_RX_FIFO_LEN)
268: 	{
269: 		chnl_cb->ctrl_rts = 1;
270: 	}
271: 
272: 	u8      old_cts = chnl_cb->status_cts;
273: 
274: 	chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_cmd->uart_rts;
275: 
276: 	/* overwrite the uart_cmd after the ISR handle completed.
277: 	 * return the rsp info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
278: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
279: 	 */
280: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)uart_cmd;
281: 
282: 	uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
283: 	uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = tx_fail;
284: 	uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
285: 
286: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != old_cts)
287: 	{
288: 		if(chnl_cb->status_cts == 0)
289: 		{
290: 			/* trigger send! */
291: 			mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);
292: 		}
293: 	}
294: 	
295: 	return;
296: }

298: static void rx_isr_state_handler(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_uart_cmd_t *uart_cmd)
299: {

301: 
302: 	chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_cmd->uart_rts;
303: 
304: 	/* overwrite the uart_cmd after the ISR handle completed.
305: 	 * return the rsp info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
306: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!

315: 	{

317: 		{
318: 			/* trigger send! */

321: 	}
322:

326: static void mb_uart_rx_isr(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_buf)
327: {
328: 	/* clear here, because rts state will be passed in response data! */
329: 	chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
330: 	
331: 	if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_SEND_DATA)
332: 	{
333: 		rx_isr_data_handler(chnl_cb, (mb_uart_cmd_t *)cmd_buf);
334: 	}
335: 	else if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_SEND_STATE)
336: 	{
337: 		rx_isr_state_handler(chnl_cb, (mb_uart_cmd_t *)cmd_buf);
338: 	}
339: 	else
340: 	{
341: 		/* overwrite the cmd_buf after the ISR handle completed.
342: 		 * return the ack info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
343: 		 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
344: 		 */
345: 		mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)cmd_buf;
346: 
347: 		uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
348: 		uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = 1;
349: 		uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
350: 	}
351: 	
352: 	return;
353: }

355: static void mb_uart_tx_cmpl_isr(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf)  /* tx_cmpl_isr */
356: {
357: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
358: 
359: 	u8      tx_fail = 0;
360: 
361: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == uart_cmd->cmd_buff. MUST be true. */
362: 
363: 	if( (ack_buf->hdr.cmd != chnl_cb->tx_cmd) || 
364: 		(chnl_cb->tx_in_process == 0) )
365: 	{
366: 		/*
367: 		 *   !!!  FAULT  !!!
368: 		 */
369: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "Fault tx_cmd:%x, rsp_cmd:%x\r\n", chnl_cb->tx_cmd, ack_buf->hdr.cmd);
370: 
371: 		return;
372: 	}
373: 
374: 	chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_rsp->uart_rts;
375: 
376: 	if(ack_buf->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL)
377: 	{
378: 		tx_fail = 0x01;
379: 	}
380: 	else
381: 	{
382: 		tx_fail = uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail;
383: 	}
384: 
385: 	/* try next Tx. */
386: 
387: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
388: 
389: 	ret_val = mb_uart_send_data(chnl_cb);
390: 
391: 	if(ret_val == BK_OK)
392: 	{
393: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
394: 	}
395: 	else
396: 	{
397: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_state_req)
398: 		{
399: 			ret_val = mb_uart_send_state(chnl_cb);
400: 			
401: 			if(ret_val == BK_OK)
402: 			{
403: 				chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
404: 			}
405: 		}
406: 	}
407: 
408: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
409: 	{
410: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;  /* clear here, because no tx_cmpl_isr callback! */
411: 	}
412: 
413: 	if(tx_fail)
414: 	{
415: 		// fail handle.
416: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "Tx Failed!\r\n");
417: 	}
418: 
419: 	if(chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback != NULL)
420: 	{
421: 		chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
422: 	}
423: 
424: 	return;
425: }

427: static bk_err_t mb_uart_init(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 chnl_id)
428: {
429: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
430: 
431: 	if(chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
432: 		return BK_OK;
433: 
434: 	memset(chnl_cb, 0, sizeof(mb_uart_cb_t));
435: 	chnl_cb->chnl_id = chnl_id;
436: 
437: 	chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff = mb_chnl_get_tx_buff(chnl_id);
438: 	chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff = mb_chnl_get_rx_buff(chnl_id);
439: 
440: 	if( (chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff == NULL) || 
441: 		(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff == NULL) )
442: 	{
443: 		return BK_FAIL;
444: 	}
445: 
446: 	ret_code = mb_chnl_open(chnl_id, chnl_cb);
447: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
448: 	{
449: 		return ret_code;
450: 	}
451: 
452: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_RX_ISR, (void *)mb_uart_rx_isr);
453: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_TX_CMPL_ISR, (void *)mb_uart_tx_cmpl_isr);
454: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_TX_ISR, NULL);
455: 
456: 	chnl_cb->chnl_inited = 1;
457: 
458: 	return BK_OK;
459: }

476: 
477: 	return BK_OK;

480: static bk_err_t mb_uart_send_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb)
481: {
482: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
483: 
484: 	u16    rem_len, cpy_len;
485: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx;
486: 
487: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != 0)
488: 	{
489: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
490: 	}
491: 
492: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx;
493: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx;
494: 
495: 	if(rd_idx <= wr_idx)
496: 	{
497: 		cpy_len = wr_idx - rd_idx;
498: 	}
499: 	else
500: 	{
501: 		cpy_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - (rd_idx - wr_idx);
502: 	}
503: 
504: 	if(cpy_len == 0)
505: 	{
506: 		return BK_FAIL;
507: 	}
508: 
509: 	if(cpy_len > MB_UART_TX_FIFO_LEN)
510: 	{
511: 		cpy_len = MB_UART_TX_FIFO_LEN;
512: 	}
513: 
514: 	if(rd_idx < wr_idx)
515: 	{
516: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, cpy_len);
517: 	}
518: 	else
519: 	{
520: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - rd_idx;
521: 
522: 		if(rem_len >= cpy_len)
523: 		{
524: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, cpy_len);
525: 		}
526: 		else
527: 		{
528: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, rem_len);
529: 
530: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff + rem_len, chnl_cb->tx_buf, cpy_len - rem_len);
531: 		}
532: 	}
533: 
534: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd = MB_UART_SEND_DATA;
535: 
536: 	mb_uart_cmd_t	uart_cmd;
537: 
538: 	uart_cmd.chnl_hdr.cmd  = MB_UART_SEND_DATA;
539: 	uart_cmd.cmd_buff      = (void *)(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff);
540: 	uart_cmd.cmd_data_len  = cpy_len;
541: 	uart_cmd.uart_rts      = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
542: 	uart_cmd.resvd         = 0;
543: 	uart_cmd.crc8          = cal_crc8_0x31(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, cpy_len);
544: 
545: 	ret_val = mb_chnl_write(chnl_cb->chnl_id, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)&uart_cmd);
546: 
547: 	if(ret_val == BK_OK)
548: 	{
549: 		chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx = (rd_idx + cpy_len) % sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
550: 	}
551: 
552: 	return ret_val;
553: }

555: static bk_err_t mb_uart_send_data_trigger(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb)
556: {
557: 	u32 flag = mb_uart_enter_critical();
558: 
559: 	if(chnl_cb->tx_in_process != 0)
560: 	{
561: 		mb_uart_exit_critical(flag);
562: 		return BK_OK;
563: 	}
564: 
565: 	chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 1;
566: 
567: 	mb_uart_exit_critical(flag);
568: 
569: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
570: 
571: 	ret_val = mb_uart_send_data(chnl_cb);
572: 
573: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
574: 	{
575: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;  /* clear here, because no tx_cmpl_isr callback! */
576: 	}
577: 
578: 	return ret_val;
579: }

612: 	chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 1;
613: 
614: 	mb_uart_exit_critical(flag);
615: 
616: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
617: 
618: 	ret_val = mb_uart_send_state(chnl_cb);
619: 
620: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
621: 	{
622: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;  /* clear here, because no tx_cmpl_isr callback! */
623: 	}
624:

628: static u16 mb_uart_write_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 * data_buf, u16 data_len)
629: {
630: 	u16    rem_len, wr_len;
631: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx;
632: 	
633: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx;
634: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx;
635: 
636: 	if(rd_idx > wr_idx)
637: 	{
638: 		rem_len = rd_idx - wr_idx - 1;  // always reserved one byte space.
639: 	}
640: 	else
641: 	{
642: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - (wr_idx - rd_idx) - 1;
643: 	}
644: 
645: 	wr_len = data_len;
646: 	if(wr_len > rem_len)
647: 		wr_len = rem_len;
648: 
649: 	if(wr_idx < rd_idx)
650: 	{
651: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, wr_len);
652: 	}
653: 	else
654: 	{
655: 		if(rd_idx != 0)
656: 			rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - wr_idx;  // if rx_idx == 0, reserved one byte at tail of the array.
657: 
658: 		if(rem_len >= wr_len)
659: 		{
660: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, wr_len);
661: 		}
662: 		else
663: 		{
664: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, rem_len);
665: 
666: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf, data_buf + rem_len, wr_len - rem_len);
667: 		}
668: 	}
669: 
670: 	chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx = (wr_idx + wr_len) % sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
671: 
672: 	/* trigger send! */
673: 	mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);
674: 
675: 	return wr_len;
676: }

678: static u16 mb_uart_read_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 * data_buf, u16 buf_len)
679: {
680: 	u16    rem_len, rd_len;
681: 
682: 	if(!chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
683: 		return 0;
684: 
685: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx, data_cnt;
686: 
687: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx;
688: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx;

693: 	}
694: 	else
695: 	{
696: 		data_cnt = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - (rd_idx - wr_idx);
697: 	}
698: 
699: 	rd_len = data_cnt;
700: 	if(rd_len > buf_len)
701: 		rd_len = buf_len;
702: 
703: 	if(rd_len == 0)
704: 	{
705: 		return 0;
706: 	}
707: 
708: 	if(rd_idx < wr_idx)
709: 	{
710: 		memcpy(data_buf, chnl_cb->rx_buf + rd_idx, rd_len);
711: 		chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx += rd_len;
712: 	}
713: 	else
714: 	{
715: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - rd_idx;
716: 
717: 		if(rem_len > rd_len)
718: 		{
719: 			memcpy(data_buf, chnl_cb->rx_buf + rd_idx, rd_len);
720: 			chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx += rd_len;
721: 		}
722: 		else
723: 		{
724: 			memcpy(data_buf, chnl_cb->rx_buf + rd_idx, rem_len);
725: 			if(rem_len < rd_len)
726: 			{
727: 				memcpy(data_buf + rem_len, chnl_cb->rx_buf, rd_len - rem_len);
728: 			}
729: 
730: 			chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx = rd_len - rem_len;
731: 		}
732: 	}
733: 
734: 	data_cnt -= rd_len;

736: 	/* rts assert...... */

738: 	{
739: 		if( chnl_cb->ctrl_rts != 0)
740: 		{
741: 			chnl_cb->ctrl_rts = 0;
742: 			mb_uart_send_state_trigger(chnl_cb);
743: 		}
744: 	}
745: 
746: 	return rd_len;
747: 
748: }

146: static void shell_uart_rx_isr(int uartn, shell_uart_ext_t *uart_ext)
147: {
148: 	u16   free_buff_len, rx_cnt = 0;
149: 	u8    rx_data;
150: 	int   ret = -1;
151: 
152: 	(void)uartn;
153: 
154: 	if(uart_ext->rx_buff_wr_idx >= uart_ext->rx_buff_rd_idx)
155: 	{
156: 	    free_buff_len = RX_BUFF_SIZE - uart_ext->rx_buff_wr_idx + uart_ext->rx_buff_rd_idx;
157: 	}
158: 	else
159: 	{
160: 		free_buff_len = uart_ext->rx_buff_rd_idx - uart_ext->rx_buff_wr_idx;
161: 	}
162: 
163: 	while(bTRUE)  /* read all data from rx-FIFO. */
164: 	{
165: 		ret = uart_read_byte_ex(uart_ext->uart_id, &rx_data);
166: 		if (ret == -1)
167: 			break;
168: 
169: 		rx_cnt++;
170: 
171: 		/* rx_buff_wr_idx == rx_buff_rd_idx means empty, so reserve one byte. */
172: 		if(rx_cnt < free_buff_len)  /* reserved one byte space. */
173: 		{
174: 			uart_ext->rx_buff[uart_ext->rx_buff_wr_idx] = rx_data;
175: 
176: 			uart_ext->rx_buff_wr_idx = (uart_ext->rx_buff_wr_idx + 1) % RX_BUFF_SIZE;
177: 
178: 		}
179: 		else
180: 		{
181: 			/* discard rx-data, rx overflow. */
182: 			uart_ext->rx_over_flow = 1; //  bTRUE; // rx overflow, disable rx interrupt to stop rx.
183: 		}
184: 	}
185: 
186: 	if(uart_ext->rx_indicate_callback != NULL)
187: 	{
188: 		uart_ext->rx_indicate_callback();
189: 	}
190: }
191: 
192: static void shell_uart_tx_isr(int uartn, shell_uart_ext_t *uart_ext)
193: {
194: 	int   ret;
195: 	(void)uartn;
196: 
197: 	while(bTRUE)  /* write data to tx-FIFO. */
198: 	{
199: 		ret = uart_write_ready(uart_ext->uart_id);
200: 		if(ret != 0)
201: 			break;
202: 
203: 		/* previous packet tx complete, check ECHO before new packet. */
204: 		if((uart_ext->cur_packet == NULL) || (uart_ext->packet_len == 0))
205: 		{
206: 			if(uart_ext->echo_rd_idx != uart_ext->echo_wr_idx) /* tx echo firstly. */
207: 			{
208: 				uart_write_byte(uart_ext->uart_id, uart_ext->echo_buff[uart_ext->echo_rd_idx]);
209: 
210: 				uart_ext->echo_rd_idx = (uart_ext->echo_rd_idx + 1) % ECHO_BUFF_SIZE;
211: 
212: 				continue;  /* continue to ECHO next byte to tx-FIFO. */
213: 			}
214: 			else
215: 			{
216: 				if(uart_ext->list_out_idx != uart_ext->list_in_idx)
217: 				{
218: 					uart_ext->cur_packet = uart_ext->tx_list[uart_ext->list_out_idx].packet;
219: 					uart_ext->packet_len = uart_ext->tx_list[uart_ext->list_out_idx].len;
220: 					uart_ext->packet_tag = uart_ext->tx_list[uart_ext->list_out_idx].tag;
221: 					uart_ext->packet_tx_len = 0;
222: 				}
223: 				else
224: 				{
225: 					/* all packets tx complete. */
226: 					/* disable tx interrupt ? */  // disable TX firstly, then set tx_stopped to 1.
227: 					bk_uart_disable_tx_interrupt(uart_ext->uart_id);
228: 
229: 					uart_ext->tx_stopped = 1; /* bTRUE;*/  /* all data tranferred, tx stopped.*/
230: 					break;
231: 				}
232: 			}
233: 		}
234: 
235: 		if(uart_ext->packet_tx_len < uart_ext->packet_len)
236: 		{
237: 			uart_write_byte(uart_ext->uart_id, uart_ext->cur_packet[uart_ext->packet_tx_len]);
238: 
239: 			uart_ext->packet_tx_len++;
240: 
241: 			continue;  /* continue to TX next byte to tx-FIFO. */
242: 		}
243: 		else
244: 		{
245: 			/* sent the whole packet, notify app. */
246: 			if(uart_ext->tx_complete_callback != NULL)
247: 			{
248: 				uart_ext->tx_complete_callback(uart_ext->cur_packet, uart_ext->packet_tag);
249: 			}
250: 
251: 			uart_ext->cur_packet = NULL;
252: 			uart_ext->packet_len = 0;
253: 			uart_ext->packet_tx_len = 0;
254: 
255: 			/* to next packet. */
256: 			uart_ext->list_out_idx = (uart_ext->list_out_idx + 1) % TX_QUEUE_LEN;
257: 
258: 			continue;   /* continue to TX next packet. */
259: 		}
260: 	}
261: 
262: }

264: static void shell_uart_tx_trigger(shell_uart_ext_t *uart_ext)

32:  * is well clear of any legitimate burst while still keeping the system
33:  * responsive in the unlikely event the peer never replies. */
34: #define MB_PHY_CHNL_BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS		200

36: typedef struct
37: {
38: 	volatile u8		tx_state;	/* physical channel tx state. */
39: 	u8		tx_seq;				/* physical channel tx sequence. */
40: 	u8		tx_log_chnl;		/* logical channel. */ /* bit7~bit4: dst/src CPU_ID, bit3~bit0: log_chnl_idx. */
41: 	u8		tx_hdr_cmd;
42: 	u32		rx_fault_cnt;
43: 	u32		tx_fault_cnt;
44: 
45: 	u32		param1;
46: 	u32		param2;
47: 	u32		param3;
48: 	/* Wall-clock (ms via rtos_get_time()) at which tx_state was set to
49: 	 * CHNL_STATE_BUSY. Used by mb_chnl_write() to detect a physical
50: 	 * channel that has been BUSY abnormally long (peer lost / dropped
51: 	 * the ACK) and forcibly clear it. 0 means "channel is IDLE". */
52: 	volatile u32	busy_since_ms;

61:  *  when CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX is set, it means from ack box ( MAILBOXn_BOX1 ).

200: static u8 mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(u8 log_chnl)
201: {
202: 	mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t	* cmd_ptr;
203: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
204: 	u16 			chnl_type;
205: 	u8				phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
206: 	u8				log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
207: 
208: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
209: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
210: 
211: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
212: 	/* for SMP project, log_chnl is always built by CPU0. it is always failed when call this API in CPU1. */
213: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
214: 		return 4;
215: #endif
216: 
217: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
218: 		return 5;
219: 
220: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
221: 		return 3;
222: 
223: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
224: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
225: 
226: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
227: 		return 1;
228: 
229: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq++;
230: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl = log_chnl;
231: 
232: 	cmd_ptr = (mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *)&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff;
233: 
234: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
235: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq;
236: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = 0;
237: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
238: 
239: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd = cmd_ptr->hdr.cmd;
240: 
241: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param1 = cmd_ptr->param1;
242: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param2 = cmd_ptr->param2;
243: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param3 = cmd_ptr->param3;
244: 
245: 	__DMB();
246: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
247: 
248: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
249: 
250: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
251: 
252: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
253: 	{
254: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
255: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
256: 
257: 		return 2;
258: 	}
259: 
260: 	s_mailbox_tx_cnt++;
261: 
262: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
263: 
264: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr != NULL)
265: 	{
266: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param);  	/* phy_chnl is BUSY now, tx_isr will not trigger phy_chnl_start_tx. */
267: 	}
268: 
269: 	return 0;
270: }

272: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(mb_phy_chnl_ack_t *ack_ptr)
273: {
274: 	u8		log_chnl;
275: 	u8		ret_code;
276: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
277: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
278: 
279: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
280: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
281: 
282: 	log_chnl = ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
283: 
284: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
285: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
286: 
287: 	s_mailbox_tx_ack_cnt++;
288: 
289: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl)) {
290: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x1;
291: 		return;
292: 	}
293: 
294: 
295: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
296: 	{
297: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x2;
298: 		return;
299: 	}
300: 
301: 
302: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM){
303: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x4;
304: 		return;
305: 	}
306: 
307: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
308: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
309: 
310: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
311: 	{
312: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x8;
313: 		return;
314: 	}
315: 
316: 	if(ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_RESET)
317: 	{
318: 		if(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
319: 		{
320: 			s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x10;
321: 			return;
322: 		}
323: 
324: 		log_chnl -= log_chnl_idx;
325: 
326: 		ack_ptr->hdr.data = 0;
327: 		ack_ptr->hdr.cmd = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd;
328: 		ack_ptr->hdr.state = CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;
329: 
330: 		log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl);
331: 
332: 		if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]) {
333: 			s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x20;
334: 			return;
335: 		}
336: 
337: 
338: 		extern bk_err_t bk_mailbox_ready(mailbox_endpoint_t src, mailbox_endpoint_t dst, uint32_t box_id);
339: 		if( bk_mailbox_ready(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx, MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL) != BK_OK)
340: 		{
341: 			s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x40;
342: 			return;
343: 		}
344: 
345: 		// log_chnl = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl;
346: 		log_chnl += log_chnl_idx;  // don't change SRC-DST cpu-id, use only the chnl-id of tx_log_chnl.
347: 		if(log_chnl != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl)
348: 		{
349: 			s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x80;
350: 			return;
351: 		}
352: 		BK_LOGD(NULL,"====mailbox reset!!%x, %x\r\n", log_chnl, phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl);
353: 		
354: 		ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq;
355: 
356: 		ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
357: 
358: 		ack_ptr->data1 = phy_chnl_ptr->param1;
359: 		ack_ptr->data2 = phy_chnl_ptr->param2;
360: 		ack_ptr->data3 = phy_chnl_ptr->param3;
361: 	}
362: 	else
363: 	if( (log_chnl != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl) ||
364: 		(ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq) )
365: 	{
366: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
367: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
368: 
369: 		/* Stale / mismatched ACK. The original implementation just
370: 		 * returned here, which left phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state stuck at
371: 		 * BUSY forever and deadlocked all subsequent mb_chnl_write()
372: 		 * on this physical channel. Recover the channel and re-dispatch
373: 		 * any pending logical-channel tx so we don't lose the link. */
374: 		{
375: 			u32 int_mask_stale = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
376: 			u8  i;
377: 
378: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
379: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
380: 
381: 			for (i = 0; i < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]; i++) {
382: 				if (log_chnl_cb_x[i].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE) {
383: 					u8 pending = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx) + i;
384: 					phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;
385: 					phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
386: 					if (mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(pending) != 0) {
387: 						log_chnl_cb_x[i].tx_state   = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
388: 						phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
389: 						phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
390: 					}
391: 					break;
392: 				}
393: 			}
394: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask_stale);
395: 		}
396: 		return;
397: 	}
398: 
399: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr != NULL)
400: 	{
401: 		/* clear following header members. */
402: 		ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
403: 		ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
404: 		ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
405: 
406: 		/* hdr.state, hdr.cmd these 2 members keep untouched. */
407: 		s_mailbox_tx_compl_cnt++;
408: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_ack_t *)ack_ptr);
409: 	} else {
410: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x100;
411: 	}
412: 
413: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
414: 	for(log_chnl_idx = 0; log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]; log_chnl_idx++)  /* priority descended search. */
415: 	{
416: 		if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
417: 			break;
418: 	}
419: 
420: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
421: 	{
422: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
423: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
424: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
425: 		return;
426: 	}
427: 
428: 	log_chnl = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx) + log_chnl_idx;
429: 
430: 	/* About to dispatch the next pending tx on this physical channel:
431: 	 * refresh the busy-watchdog timestamp so its lifetime starts from
432: 	 * here rather than carrying over from the previous transaction. */
433: 	phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
434: 
435: 	ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
436: 
437: 	if(ret_code != 0)
438: 	{
439: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
440: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state               = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
441: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms          = 0;
442: 	}
443: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
444: 
445: 	return;
446: 
447: }

449: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
450: {
451: 	phy_chnnl_hdr_t  chnl_hdr;
452: 	u8			log_chnl = cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
453: 	bk_err_t	ret_code;
454: 	u16 		chnl_type;
455: 
456: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
457: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
458: 
459: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
460: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
461: 
462: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = SRC_CPU_ID; from SRC_CPU.
463: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
464: 
465: 	s_mailbox_rx_cnt++;
466: 
467: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
468: 		return;
469: 
470: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
471: 		return;
472: 
473: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
474: 		return;
475: 
476: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
477: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
478: 
479: 	chnl_hdr.data = cmd_ptr->hdr.data;
480: 
481: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
482: 	{
483: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
484: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
485: 
486: 		return;
487: 	}
488: 
489: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr != NULL)
490: 	{
491: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
492: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
493: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
494: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
495: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
496: 
497: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr);
498: 
499: 		/* !!!! cmd_ptr buffer now contains ACK data !!!!. */
500: 	}
501: 	else
502: 	{
503: 		chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;		/* cmd NO target app, it is an ACK bit to peer CPU. */
504: 	}
505: 
506: 	if(chnl_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX)
507: 	{
508: 		/* sync tx cmd, do NOT send ACK. */
509: 		return;
510: 	}
511: 
512: 	/* mb_phy_chnl_tx_ack. */
513: 
514: 	/* RE-USE the cmd buffer for ACK !!! */
515: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.data  = chnl_hdr.data;
516: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl |= CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX;			/* ACK msg, use the ACK channel.  */
517: 
518: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_ACK_CHNL;
519: 
520: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
521: 
522: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send_safe((mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);	/* mb_phy_chnl_tx_ack. */
523: 
524: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
525: 	{
526: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
527: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
528: 
529: 		return;
530: 	}
531: 
532: 	s_mailbox_rx_ack_cnt++;
533: 	return;
534: }

536: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr(mailbox_data_t * mb_data)
537: {
538: 	mb_phy_chnl_union_t	rx_data;
539: 
540: 	rx_data.mb_data.param0 = mb_data->param0;
541: 	rx_data.mb_data.param1 = mb_data->param1;
542: 	rx_data.mb_data.param2 = mb_data->param2;
543: 	rx_data.mb_data.param3 = mb_data->param3;
544: 	/* the following process will damage the input parameter,
545: 	so pass in the pointer of copied parameter instad of the original. */
546: 
547: 	/*
548: 	 *  there are 2 boxes in one MAILBOXn HW,
549: 	 *  but no way to know which box this msg is from in current mailbox_driver design.
550: 	 *  so use the CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX bit in the msg hdr.ctrl to distinguish where it is from.
551: 	 *  when CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX is set, it means from ack box ( MAILBOXn_BOX1 ).
552: 	 */
553: 	if(rx_data.phy_ch_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX)		/* rx ack. */
554: 	{
555: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_ack);
556: 	}
557: 	else		/* rx cmd. */
558: 	{
559: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_cmd);
560: 	}
561: }

563: static void mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(u8 log_chnl)
564: {
565: 	u8		ret_code;
566: 
567: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
568: 
569: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
570: 
571: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
572: 
573: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
574: 		return;
575: 
576: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
577: 		return;
578: 
579: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
580: 
581: 	if(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
582: 	{
583: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;		/* MUST set channel state to BUSY firstly. */
584: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
585: 		/* start_tx->tx_cmd->tx_isr callback->mb_chnl_write->start_tx, it is a loop.
586: 		   break the loop by setting the phy_chnl_cb.tx_state to busy. */
587: 
588: 		ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
589: 
590: 		if(ret_code != 0)
591: 		{
592: 			/* tx_cmd failed before the data hit hardware: roll back BOTH
593: 			 * physical and logical state, so the caller can retry and so
594: 			 * the logical channel does not stay BUSY forever. */
595: 			u8                   log_chnl_idx_fail = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
596: 			mb_log_chnl_cb_t    *log_chnl_cb_x_fail =
597: 				(mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
598: 
599: 			if (log_chnl_idx_fail < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]) {
600: 				log_chnl_cb_x_fail[log_chnl_idx_fail].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
601: 			}
602: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
603: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
604: 		}
605: 	}
606: 
607: 	return;
608: }

613: {
614: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
615: 	u16 			chnl_type;
616:

619: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;

621: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP

623: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
624: #endif
625: 
626: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
627: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
628: 
629: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
630: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
631: 
632: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
633: 
634: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
635: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = 0;
636: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX;
637: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;

639: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;

641: 	s_mailbox_sync_cnt++;
642: 	
643: 	/*
644: 	 * can't wait 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' to be CHNL_STATE_IDLE here,
645: 	 * 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' is set to CHNL_STATE_IDLE in interrupt callback.
646: 	 * but the interrupt may be disabled when this API is called.
647: 	 *    wait physical channel HW to be IDLE by <POLLing> !!
648: 	 */
649: 	while(1)
650: 	{
651: 		ret_code = bk_mailbox_send_safe((mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
652: 
653: 		if(ret_code != BK_ERR_MAILBOX_TIMEOUT)
654: 		{
655: 			break;
656: 		}
657: 	}
658: 
659: 	return ret_code;

663: /* =====================      logical channel APIs      ==================*/
664: /*
665:   * init logical chnanel module.
666:   * return:
667:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
668:   *     failed  : fail code.
669:   *
670:   */
671: bk_err_t mb_chnl_init(void)
672: {
673: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
674: 	int				i, j;
675: 
676: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
677: 
678: 	/*
679: 	 * mb_chnl_init() is reached from mb_chnl_open(), which is called by
680: 	 * many subsystems (shell log forwarding, ipc_init, mb_uart, ...).
681: 	 * Each one of those callers runs on its own FreeRTOS task and they
682: 	 * can race here:
683: 	 *
684: 	 *   Task A: enters mb_chnl_open(MB_CHNL_LOG), sees mb_chnnl_init_ok==0,
685: 	 *           enters mb_chnl_init(), runs all the memset's, sets
686: 	 *           mb_chnnl_init_ok=1, returns. Caller then sets
687: 	 *           log_chnl_cb2[15].in_used=1 and installs rx_isr.
688: 	 *   Task B (preempted in the middle of mb_chnl_open before the
689: 	 *           init_ok check finishes): comes back, sees init_ok still
690: 	 *           == 0 (because it sampled before A set it), enters
691: 	 *           mb_chnl_init() AGAIN, and the memset wipes the
692: 	 *           log_chnl_cb_x[] array that A just populated.
693: 	 *
694: 	 * Fix: serialize the body with the existing critical section so the
695: 	 * "if (init_ok) return; ... init_ok = 1;" sequence is atomic w.r.t.
696: 	 * other tasks. The double-check pattern still keeps the fast path
697: 	 * lock-free once init has completed.
698: 	 */
699: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
700: 	{
701: 		return BK_OK;
702: 	}
703: 
704: 	uint32_t init_int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
705: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
706: 	{
707: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
708: 		return BK_OK;
709: 	}
710: 
711: 	memset(&phy_chnl_x_cb, 0, sizeof(phy_chnl_x_cb));
712: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
713: 	{
714: 		phy_chnl_x_cb[i].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
715: 
716: 		log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[i]);
717: 
718: 		memset(log_chnl_cb_x, 0, sizeof(mb_log_chnl_cb_t) * phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]);
719: 
720: 		for(j = 0; j < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]; j++)
721: 		{
722: 			log_chnl_cb_x[j].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
723: 		}
724: 	}
725: 
726: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_init();
727: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
728: 	{
729: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
730: 		return ret_code;
731: 	}
732: 
733: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu;
734: 
735: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
736: 	{
737: 		dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(i);  // dst_cpu_id;
738: 
739: 		bk_mailbox_recv_callback_register(dst_cpu, SELF_CPU, mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr);
740: 	}
741: 
742: 	mb_chnnl_init_ok = 1;
743: 
744: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
745: 
746: 	return BK_OK;
747: }

859: /*
860:   * write to logical chnanel.
861:   * input:
862:   *     log_chnl     : logical channel id to write.
863:   *     cmd_buf     : buffer of channel cmd data.
864:   * return:
865:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
866:   *     failed  : fail code.
867:   *
868:   */
869: bk_err_t mb_chnl_write(u8 log_chnl, mb_chnl_cmd_t * cmd_buf)
870: {
871: 	u16		write_len;
872: 
873: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
874: 	u8		log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
875: 
876: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
877: 
878: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
879: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
880: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
881: #endif
882: 
883: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
884: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
885: 
886: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
887: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
888: 
889: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
890: 
891: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
892: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
893: 
894: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].in_used == 0)
895: 		return BK_ERR_STATE;
896: 
897: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
898: 
899: 	/* If the physical channel has been BUSY abnormally long (peer never
900: 	 * sent ACK / lost interrupt / lost ack), forcibly recover it so this
901: 	 * and all future mb_chnl_write() calls on the channel don't deadlock. */
902: 	{
903: 		mb_phy_chnl_cb_t *phy_cb_chk = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
904: 
905: 		if ((phy_cb_chk->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_BUSY) && (phy_cb_chk->busy_since_ms != 0))
906: 		{
907: 			u32 now = rtos_get_time();
908: 			u32 age = now - phy_cb_chk->busy_since_ms;	/* unsigned wrap is fine for short windows */
909: 
910: 			if (age >= MB_PHY_CHNL_BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS)
911: 			{
912: 				phy_cb_chk->tx_fault_cnt++;
913: 				phy_cb_chk->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x20000000;	/* mark "BUSY-stuck recovered" */
914: 				phy_cb_chk->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
915: 				phy_cb_chk->busy_since_ms = 0;
916: 			}
917: 		}
918: 	}
919: 
920: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
921: 	{
922: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
923: 
924: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
925: 	}
926: 
927: 	write_len = sizeof(mailbox_data_t) > sizeof(mb_chnl_cmd_t) ? sizeof(mb_chnl_cmd_t) : sizeof(mailbox_data_t);
928: 
929: 	memcpy(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, cmd_buf, write_len);
930: 
931: 	/* set to BUSY means there is data in tx-buff. mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr will get it to send. */
932: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;   /* MUST set to BUSY after data was copied. */
933: 	__DMB();
934: 
935: 	mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(log_chnl);
936: 
937: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
938: 
939: 	return BK_OK;
940: }

789: 				&& (0xe0U == (UINT8)inbuf[1])
790: 				&& (0xfcU == (UINT8)inbuf[2])
791: 				&& (*bp == 3)) {
792: 				uint8_t ch = inbuf[*bp];
793: 				uint8_t left = ch, len = 4 + (uint8_t)ch;
794: 				inbuf[*bp] = ch;
795: 				(*bp)++;
796: 
797: 				if (ch >= INBUF_SIZE) {
798: 					BK_LOGD(NULL,"Error: input buffer overflow\r\n");
799: 					BK_LOGD(NULL,PROMPT);
800: 					*bp = 0;
801: 					return 0;
802: 				}
803: 
804: 				while (left--) {
805: 					if (0 == cli_getchar((char *)&ch))
806: 						break;
807: 
808: 					inbuf[*bp] = ch;
809: 					(*bp)++;
810: 				}
811: 
812: 				bkreg_run_command(inbuf, len);
813: 				os_memset(inbuf, 0, len);
814: 				*bp = 0;
815: 				continue;
816: 			}
817: 		}
818: #endif
819: 		/* find first invalid input data, discard input data more than 0x7f */
820: 		if ((uint8_t)inbuf[0] > 0x7f) {
821: 			continue;
822: 		}
823: 		if (inbuf[*bp] == RET_CHAR)
824: 			continue;
825: 		if (inbuf[*bp] == END_CHAR) {   /* end of input line */
826: 			inbuf[*bp] = '\0';
827: 			*bp = 0;
828: 			return 1;
829: 		}
830: 
831: 		if ((inbuf[*bp] == 0x08) || /* backspace */
832: 			(inbuf[*bp] == 0x7f)) { /* DEL */
833: 			if (*bp > 0) {
834: 				(*bp)--;
835: 				if (!pCli->echo_disabled)
836: 					BK_LOGD(NULL,"%c %c", 0x08, 0x08);
837: 			}
838: 			continue;
839: 		}
840: 
841: 		if (inbuf[*bp] == '\t') {
842: 			inbuf[*bp] = '\0';
843: 			tab_complete(inbuf, bp);
844: 			continue;
845: 		}
846: 
847: 		if (!pCli->echo_disabled)
848: 			BK_LOGD(NULL,"%c", inbuf[*bp]);
849: 
850: 		(*bp)++;
851: 		if (*bp >= INBUF_SIZE) {
852: 			BK_LOGD(NULL,"Error: input buffer overflow\r\n");
853: 			BK_LOGD(NULL,PROMPT);
854: 			*bp = 0;
855: 			return 0;
856: 		}
857: 	}
858: 
859: 	return 0;

112: static int ipc_heartbeat_timeout(void)
113: {
114: 	u32   cur_time;
115: 
116: 	cur_time = (u32)rtos_get_time();
117: 
118: 	if(cpu_x_state == CORE_POWER_OFF)
119: 	{
120: 		return 0;
121: 	}
122: 	if((cpu_x_state == CORE_STARTING) || (cpu_x_dump != 0))
123: 	{
124: 		cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp = cur_time;
125: 		return 0;
126: 	}
127: 
128: 	if(cur_time >= cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp)
129: 	{
130: 		cur_time -= cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp;
131: 	}
132: 	else
133: 	{
134: 		cur_time += (~(cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp)) + 1;  // wrap around.
135: 	}
136: 
137: 	if(cur_time < HB_TIMEOUT_MS)
138: 	{
139: 		cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp = (u32)rtos_get_time();
140: 		return 0;
141: 	}
142: 
143: 	if (bk_pm_module_lv_sleep_state_get(PM_DEV_ID_DEFAULT))
144: 	{
145: 		cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp = (u32)rtos_get_time();
146: 		bk_pm_module_lv_sleep_state_clear(PM_DEV_ID_DEFAULT);
147: 		return 0;
148: 	}
149: 
150: 	if(s_mb_ipc_work_state == MB_IPC_EXIT_LV)
151: 	{
152: 		cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp = (u32)rtos_get_time();
153: 		s_mb_ipc_work_state = MB_IPC_WORKING;
154: 		return 0;
155: 	}
156: 
157: 	return 1;

218: static void mb_ipc_task( void *para )
219: {
220: 	bk_err_t	ret_val;
221: 	u32    events;
222: 	u32    check_time = BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER;
223: 
224: 	mb_ipc_init_lv_callback();
225: 
226: 	ret_val = rtos_init_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event);
227: 
228: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
229: 	{
230: 		rtos_delete_thread(NULL);
231: 		return;
232: 	}
233: 
234: 	while(1)
235: 	{
236: 		events = rtos_wait_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event, MB_IPC_ALL_FLAGS, true, check_time);
237: 
238: 		if(events == 0)
239: 		{
240: 			// timeout, so check heartbeat.
241: 			events = MB_IPC_HEARTBEAT_FLAG;
242: 		}
243: 
244: 		if(events & MB_IPC_STOP_CORE_FLAG)  // process this event at first!!!!
245: 		{
246: 			if(cpu_x_state == CORE_POWER_OFF)
247: 			{
248: 				events = 0;  // clear all events.
249: 			}
250: 		}
251: 		
252: 		if(events & MB_IPC_START_CORE_FLAG)
253: 		{
254: 			u8   retry_cnt = 0;
255: 
256: 			while(cpu_x_state == CORE_STARTING)
257: 			{
258: 				ipc_heartbeat_timeout();
259: 				
260: 				if(events & MB_IPC_POWER_UP_FLAG)
261: 				{
262: 					if(cpu_x_state == CORE_STARTING)
263: 					{
264: 						cpu_x_state = CORE_POWER_ON;
265: 						break;  // cpu1 power on. 
266: 					}
267: 				}
268: 				else
269: 				{
270: 					if( retry_cnt > 3)
271: 					{
272: 						BK_DUMP_OUT("IPC retry to start core%d, retry_cnt:%d\r\n", cpu_x_id, retry_cnt);
273: 						// restart_cpu_x();
274: 						break;
275: 					}
276: 					else
277: 					{
278: 						events = rtos_wait_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event, MB_IPC_POWER_UP_FLAG, true, 2000);//2s
279: 					}
280: 				}
281: 
282: 				retry_cnt++;
283: 			}
284: 
285: 			// discard this event when not in CORE_STARTING state.
286: 		}
287: 		
288: 		if(events & MB_IPC_HEARTBEAT_FLAG)
289: 		{
290: 			if(ipc_heartbeat_timeout())
291: 			{
292: 				BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "IPC[%d]heartbeat timeout %d,%d\r\n",cpu_x_id,cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp,(u32)rtos_get_time());
293: 				/*when cpu1 heartbeat timeout, then system reboot*/
294: 				cpu_x_heartbeat_timeout = 1;
295: 				BK_ASSERT(false);
296: 			}
297: 		}
298: 
299: 		if(cpu_x_state == CORE_POWER_OFF)
300: 		{
301: 			check_time = BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER;
302: 		}
303: 		else
304: 		{
305: 			check_time = HB_TIMEOUT_MS;
306: 		}
307: 	}
308: }

**结论**
当前 CP 只实现 `AP MB_UART0 -> CP 按行聚合 -> shell UART0 输出`，没有 UART0 输入转发、输入 owner 切换、RAW console、link-down 自动回退或可靠 TX。比赛仓 external 也只权威覆盖 `driver.c` 和 RAM CSV，尚不满足移植计划第 8、10.2 节。

只读核验的 SHA-256 表明两个现有覆盖均与构建树逐字节一致：

- `driver.c`: `76bfc61bdbb0013f5edacf3584b106f290f365eb0557e50e975d27806eda33ab`
- `ram_regions.csv`: `62342cb9f3ddf5a5411b29d5d4374c58bcc44469172f576808fdbc2d85616d4c`

**现有实现**
- [移植计划](/home/mi/vela_competition/BK7258_OPENVELA_UART0_MAILBOX_V2_PORTING_PLAN.md:435) `435-501` 定义 CP 双向桥、RAW/LOG、owner 状态机和驱动加固；[具体覆盖清单](/home/mi/vela_competition/BK7258_OPENVELA_UART0_MAILBOX_V2_PORTING_PLAN.md:577) `577-589` 明确 external 目前不完整。
- [driver.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c:42) `42-165`：二值 semaphore、独立 `ap_uart0_log` 线程、256 字节行缓存、50 ms 半行刷新、`ap0:` 前缀、最多三次 shell 队列重试。
- 同文件 [初始化顺序](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c:452) `452-464`：`ipc_init()` 后初始化 MB_UART0 bridge，随后 `mb_ipc_init()`、`bk_ipc_init()`；MB_UART0 当前只初始化一次。
- [MB_UART API](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/include/driver/mb_uart_driver.h:40) `40-189`：init/deinit、RX/TX callback、read/write-ready、部分 read/write、tx-over、clear-on-read status。callback 明确运行于关中断上下文，不能 sleep、flush shell 或做复杂切换。
- [mb_uart_driver.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c:74) `74-113`：TX 环实际容量128字节，RX环实际容量256字节；已有 DATA/STATE、RTS/CTS和两个 callback。
- 同文件 [RX处理](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c:179) `179-295` 只检查 payload 非空、长度非零及环空间，没有验证 `cmd_buff == rx_xchg_buff`、`len <= 128`或完整保留字段。
- 同文件 [初始化缺陷](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c:427) `427-456` 第二个 NULL 检查错误地再次检查 `tx_xchg_buff`；[发送](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c:480) `480-552` 在 logical write 成功时提前推进 `tx_rd_idx`，远端失败无法回滚。
- DATA/STATE 的局部 `uart_cmd` 未整体清零，见 [DATA构造](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c:536) `536-545` 和 [STATE构造](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c:581) `581-597`。
- [logical channel](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c:200) `200-269` 按 logical index 调度；[ACK匹配](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c:272) `272-445` 只可靠比较 channel/sequence，未把 cmd 纳入普通 ACK 匹配。
- 同文件 `316-322` 收到 peer RESET 且当前空闲时直接静默返回；`363-396` stale ACK 会强制释放物理 BUSY；`899-918` 200 ms 超时只在下一次 `mb_chnl_write()` 时检查并直接清 BUSY，都会导致仍被 FIFO 引用的 slot 被复用。
- [mailbox_channel.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h:157) `157-165` 声明了 `MB_CHNL_TX_RESET`，但 [mb_chnl_ctrl()](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c:981) `981-1015` 没有实现该 case。
- [mbox0_adapter.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.c:4) `4-13,73-128` 为每个目的 CPU 仅准备两个 slot，忽略 command/ACK box 参数并无条件轮转，不能证明对端已复制后再复用。
- [交换区映射](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_chnl_buff.c:37) `37-49,64-134` 将 UART0 映射为 SWAP 第三个 `0x200` 区；由 [RAM CSV](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv:6) `6-10` 推得 CP TX=`0x2809fc00`、CP RX=`0x2809fd00`。
- [shell_uart.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_cli/shell_uart.c:146) `146-190` 是 UART0 唯一 RX ISR owner；[注册](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_cli/shell_uart.c:330) `330-351` 直接覆盖 UART driver 的单 callback，因此 bridge 不能再注册 UART0 ISR。
